title: Guitar with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='44' y='8' width='12' height='38' rx='3' fill='#c58a3c'/>
  <!-- frets -->
  <rect x='44' y='16' width='12' height='2.5' fill='#f4d27a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='24' width='12' height='2.5' fill='#f4d27a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='32' width='12' height='2.5' fill='#f4d27a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='40' width='12' height='2.5' fill='#f4d27a'/>
  <!-- headstock -->
  <rect x='41' y='2' width='18' height='12' rx='4' fill='#a86e28'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='6' r='2' fill='#f4d27a'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='6' r='2' fill='#f4d27a'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='10' r='2' fill='#f4d27a'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='10' r='2' fill='#f4d27a'/>
  <!-- body upper bout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#e8a33d'/>
  <!-- body lower bout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='30' ry='18' fill='#e8a33d'/>
  <!-- body light rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#f5c96b'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='26' ry='14' fill='#f5c96b'/>
  <!-- sound hole -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='68' r='9' fill='#7a4418'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='68' r='9' fill='none' stroke='#a86e28' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='42' y='88' width='16' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7a4418'/>
  <!-- strings -->
  <line x1='47' y1='12' x2='47' y2='89' stroke='#f7e7b0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='12' x2='50' y2='89' stroke='#f7e7b0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='12' x2='53' y2='89' stroke='#f7e7b0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- smiling face -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='60' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#3b1f06'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='60' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#3b1f06'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='59' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='59' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M43 65 Q50 73 57 65' stroke='#3b1f06' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='65' r='3' fill='#f28a8a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='65' r='3' fill='#f28a8a' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
